title: Tests keep passing on helper pieces that no screen uses any more
what: Five small helpers each have their own passing test, but no screen calls them: the old History tab's keep-the-search-box rule (the History tab is gone), the 3 by 3 effort grid (the effort sheet draws a plain list instead), the 'has this set sheet changed' check, the profile tile stacking check and the in-use sign's title. A green test here says nothing about what members see.
expected: Each tested helper is the one the screen really uses, or it is deleted with its test.
fix_line: Wire each helper into its screen or delete it with its test

title: Three leftover pieces nothing uses: the step-back reason line, a progress mode list and a licence link
what: The rule that decides when to show 'Stuck at 45 kg, so a small step back' is never called (the reason now comes another way), a list of progress modes is never read, and the drawings' licence link is a second copy of the one the Credits page really uses. They look live but do nothing, so a future fix may land in the wrong copy.
expected: No unused copies: one reason rule, one licence link.

title: No test ever shows the 'Try a lighter weight?' card appearing
what: The card that offers a lighter weight when a lift is stuck has no test of its own. The phone test flows only check that it is NOT on screen, and the engine tests only check that no offer is made. If the card stopped appearing, or showed the wrong weights, every test would still pass.
expected: At least one test where a stuck lift brings up the card with the right question and the two buttons, and it goes once a set is ticked.
fix_line: Add one test where the card appears and one where ticking hides it

title: 'Save as routine' can fail with a message but leaves no record of why
what: When the folder list cannot be read for 'Save as routine', the member sees a calm try-again message, but the error itself is thrown away. Every other workout action records its error first, so this one cannot be diagnosed from a phone log.
expected: The error is written to the log before the message shows, like the other actions.
how_often: rarely, when the folder read fails
fix_line: Log the error before showing the message
